_comment: EXAMPLE / PLACEHOLDER — informational only. Actual booking duration/buffer/hours enforced by the app come from environment variables (BOOKING_DURATION_MINUTES, BOOKING_BUFFER_MINUTES, BUSINESS_HOURS_START/END, BUSINESS_DAYS).
howToBook: Customers can ask to book an appointment directly in WhatsApp. The assistant will ask which service, then a preferred date, check real availability, and confirm before booking.
